Hi Jordan — quick answers plus a short playbook below. Happy to jump on a call for details.

Short answers: 
- Default retention: 90 days for audit/access logs in hosted tier. Configurable retention up to 365 days on Redwood Console for dedicated accounts; beyond 365 we recommend customer-managed export/archive.
- Exports: Yes — ad-hoc exports available. We provide an exported NDJSON bundle and an automated daily export job to a customer-controlled S3 bucket. Exports can be targeted to specific regions; we will write to your US-east-1 bucket.
- Integrity: Exports are signed with HMAC-SHA256 and accompanied by a manifest file with checksums. We also support optional PGP signing on request.
- Deletion: On termination we run a verified deletion procedure. We provide a deletion certificate (timestamped manifest) and can perform an independent forensic export prior to wipe if you request it within the retention window.
- Retention clock: Starts at event ingestion time (server-side timestamp). For replicated/archived bundles the written timestamp is included in the manifest.

Playbook (high level):
1) Discovery: Confirm bucket name + IAM role (we support cross-account role). Provide least-privilege role ARN.
2) PoC export: We run a one-off NDJSON export for the last 30 days to your bucket (HMAC manifest attached).
3) Schedule: If daily export desired, we configure the scheduled export + alerting to your SSO group.
4) Long-term archive: For >365 days retention we recommend exporting to your cold storage (Glacier/Archive) and maintain our manifests for chain-of-custody.
5) Termination: Confirm export receipt, initiate deletion job, provide deletion certificate and HMAC manifest for final archive.

Attachment: export_playbook_v1.md (playbook + checklist)
